Give reasons for the following:

i) Polyvinylchloride is more crystalline than polystyrene.
ii) Chitosan is a polymeric biomaterial used for wound healing
iii) Ball milling method is not suitable for preparing polymer nanoparticles
iv) Organic light emitting diode (OLED) displays are superior to liquid crystal displays (LCD)
Illustrate the mechanism of photo-responsive and electro-responsive polymers.

A sample of polypropylene has the degree of polymerization of 410, 550 and 600 was found to have the composition of 25%, 35% and 40% respectively. Calculate the number average and weight average molecular mass of it.
Explain the stepwise working of a continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) biosensor.

A 50 mL sample of a monoprotic weak acid is titrated with 0.1000 M NaOH. The equivalence point is reached after adding 10 mL of NaOH. At the half-equivalence point the measured pH = 4.700. (a) Find Ka of the acid, (b) Find the initial concentration of the acid, (c) Calculate the pH after adding 5 mL NaOH.
